summary: Cheche Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, with an accompanying press release announcing the launch of the ABAO Agent Family, a suite of five AI agents built on its proprietary insurance large language model, focused on the NEV insurance value chain. The filing is purely a product/business update, listing external agents for claims and underwriting, and internal agents for operational workflows, with efficiency metrics. No financial terms, advisors, or structural actions are included. This is not a special situation event; it is a routine operational announcement under a foreign private issuer report.
